title: StoneEra is heading to Early Access on November 6!
author: Arrock12
selftext:
StoneEra started as my solo project: a medieval voxel colony game where your villagers build the settlement you design.

Now I’m planning to bring it to **Steam Early Access on November 6, 2026** .

The full game opens up research, crafting, and construction beyond the demo’s progression. You’ll guide your villagers, develop production chains, trade with a travelling merchant, raise animals, and engineer flowing water—all in a world you can reshape.

There’s still plenty to improve. StoneEra will enter Early Access with bugs and rough edges, and your feedback will help guide its development.

A big thank you to everyone who has tried the demo, reported problems, or shared their settlements.

**The free demo is available now. Try it or wishlist the full game here:**

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5057770/StoneEra/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5057770/StoneEra/)

What would you like to build first?
